name: Izana Von Xnbrave
original_name: イザナ・フォン・ザンブレイブ
source:
The head of the Xnbrave clan and Rufus Xnbrave's wife. Outside of public knowledge, she is one of the Four Gods who rule Canterbury and is also the head of its special forces, the Ibuyashuu. 

Extremely open with regards to sex, her range includes males and females. She can act as the chaste and loving spouse one minute, a scheming black widow the next. 

[Spoiler]Her name prior to the Catastrophe was Kamishiro Izana. A member of the research team working on the dimensional reactor, she became immortal after the Catastrophe together with her companions. A virtual reality junkie, the loss of that technology in the post-Catastrophe world is one reason why she is so keen on sex for pleasure. Sex is also used for procreation as the Gods resort to inbreeding to increase the number of talented pawns they can deploy to manage the country.

Izana's power works on a very simple concept; she draws energy from a higher dimension and expels it in devastating bursts using cannons shaped like circular crystals. [/Spoiler]
